name: Road to De Other Side Normal trash hits a level 25 player like Vaults of the Inquisition, not like Mythic
contract: Road to De Other Side (map 937) had no Heroic/Mythic creature templates, so its Normal tier used the Mythic DamageModifier (Interstitial Wanderer 4) and hit far harder than Vaults of the Inquisition. Its trash now has templates at +100000/+200000 that keep those values, and the Normal templates are fitted at level 25: on live (2026-09 logs, same tank, level 10 creatures) Road hit like Vaults, so the Road targets are the 2026-09 Road medians times the Vaults June/September ratio (9.27): Interstitial Wanderer (162765) 111 and Spider of the Other Side (162770) 46. The class 1 average blow at level 25 is 40.5 per point of DamageModifier (see vaults-normal-melee-level-25), so the Normal templates carry 2.75 and 1.146. DestinyWeaver scales Road's Normal tier with finder entry 402 (band 15-59).
